body.prompt: Wide shot inside the marble Roman Senate house in daylight, rows of senators in white togas lean toward each other and whisper behind their hands while the emperor sits apart and silent, shafts of sunlight.
Daylight in the Roman Senate, senators in white togas whisper behind their hands and glance sideways at the emperor in the front row who looks straight ahead.
The Roman emperor Marcus Aurelius in a white toga with a purple stripe sits silent and still on a marble bench in the Senate in daylight, senators blurred around him.
Close-up of the Roman emperor Marcus Aurelius' calm face in soft daylight in the Senate, grey curly hair and beard, steady eyes looking ahead, slow push-in.
The Roman Forum at bright midday, a large crowd in tunics and togas gathered before a marble temple listening to a speaker, hard sunlight, wide establishing shot.
Bright midday in the Roman Forum, the camera pushes over the heads of a dense crowd toward a speaker on the temple steps, marble columns in sunlight.
A Roman legion in a tight wall of red shields advances through a rain-soaked pine forest on the Danube frontier, eagle standard above the ranks, grey daylight and mist, wide low-angle shot.
Roman legionaries behind a wall of wet red shields in a misty forest, helmets glistening with rain, eagle standard behind them, the camera pushes in toward the front rank.
Night, a frosted Roman army camp under a vast Milky Way, glowing tents and small campfires, the emperor stands alone as a small figure seen from behind, wide shot.
Night in a Roman army camp, back view of the emperor in a cloak looking up at the Milky Way, his breath visible, a tent and campfires glowing beside him.
Night, the Roman emperor Marcus Aurelius writes with a quill at a rough wooden desk inside a leather tent by a single candle, blue night camp behind him.
Night in a leather tent, the Roman emperor stops writing, lifts his eyes from the papyrus beside a candle and stares ahead thinking, slow push-in on his face.
Night, the Roman emperor writes slowly with a reed pen on papyrus at a desk in a dark tent lit by one candle flame, scrolls on the table.
Night close-up of the Roman emperor's face lit by candle in a dark tent, grey curly hair and beard, he stares into the darkness, bronze brooch on a crimson cloak.
